data.overview: A a northern city shuttle driver agrees to take a stranded traveler across state lines for welcome cash. The man's story soon unravels, and the driver realizes the ride could place many lives in danger unless he finds a way to stop it.
data.tagline: The fare is more than he bargained for.
data.title: The Passenger from the North
